visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a young man with pink hair and glasses sitting at a mahjong table, looking intently at his tiles. He has prominent tattoos on his arms. (2) The camera cuts to a young woman with long blonde hair across the table, who excitedly reveals her winning hand and points at her tiles. (3) Back to the man, who looks frustrated, holding his cards while more mahjong tiles are scattered on the table in front of him. (4) The woman wins again, and the man throws his cards onto the table in annoyance. (5) The woman begins talking to the camera, holding a white and green bottle of body lotion. (6) A close-up shows the bottle, 'Cellina Derma AC-Repair', with various labels and text on it. (7) The man applies the white lotion to his tattooed forearm while the woman explains the product. (8) The woman holds two different bottles of the same brand, comparing their features. (9) The man looks at his arm, appearing satisfied, while they both sit back at the mahjong table with the product nearby.

A male voice speaks briefly in a low tone, followed by an excited female voice shouting about winning. No BGM is present yet. (2) A hard impact sound is heard as tiles hit the table. The man complains about his loss with a rising pitch. (3) An upbeat, acoustic guitar-driven BGM fades in. The female voice shifts to a clear, professional narrative tone, introducing the lotion. (4) The sound of a pump being pressed is clearly audible, accompanied by a 'ding' sound effect for emphasis. (5) The male voice returns, asking clarifying questions about the product's benefits with moderate arousal. (6) The woman explains the different variants, her voice bright and persuasive. (7) The BGM continues steadily as both voices engage in a final lighthearted banter with laughing sounds. (8) A final 'pop' sound effect marks the end of the promotional segment.
